findings.finding: All actual-looking institution identities replaced with explicit generic fictional venue names/descriptions; opening hours and addresses null. Source city/scenario/location IDs, route grouping and Work/Study/Travel/Shopping/Administrative contexts retained.

Precision-parts inspection corrected from Construction Site to existing Factory/Factory Worker. Dialogue distinguishes pending status from a final defect count; no measurement procedure or acceptance threshold invented.
Japanese-language class corrected from Museum/Teacher to existing Classroom/Teacher, preserving Study context with no proficiency gate.

Other existing categories/jobs retained. Onsen staff explains hypothetical photography signs without health guarantee. Shrine staff does not guarantee service or benefits. Licensing officer refers foreign-license conditions without certifying validity or translation acceptance. Tax officer does not determine tax liability or payment relief. Retail/ramen features are scene-specific hypothetical facts, not current facility policies.
